breaking_changes_allowlist.summary: pre-GA clean cut makes durable terminal truth the workload DELETE authority; missing durable release fact plus pod absence returns fail-closed retryable 409 workload_release_incomplete, release facts require the ConfigMap fact store/RBAC path, and workspace-binding reconciliation is fail-closed when provider prerequisites or binding state cannot be proven.

pre-GA workload and binding Kubernetes object names are now scope-qualified hashed identities; workload Pod status, keepalive, exec, release, and delete paths validate Pod annotations and labels against URL workspace/project/workload scope before operating.
